availability.measurement: One hourly observation is good only when every canonical external journey stage passes.

good_conditions: room list returns a JSON array
room creation returns a valid waiting room
room join returns the exact connection contract
two unique WebSocket players receive joined messages
room cleanup is observed after disconnect
journey.failure_output: Aggregate stage identifier and bounded failure code only; no room IDs, player names, addresses, tokens, URLs, response bodies, or request IDs.

external_result.one_observation_rule: total is exactly 1 for every executed check; good is 1 only when all stages pass; failed is 1 otherwise

diagnostics.purpose: Private native metrics diagnose latency, saturation, and lifecycle behavior; they do not calculate public availability or replace external SLO evidence.

metrics.privacy: No metric series may contain user, room, address, token, URL, request ID, or arbitrary input data.

pong_slo_journey_total.meaning: raw executed canonical external journey observations

pong_slo_journey_good_total.meaning: raw canonical external journey observations where every stage passed

pong_slo_journey_failed_total.meaning: raw canonical external journey observations that failed at any stage

pong_slo_journey_status.meaning: derived operational health status only; 1 healthy, 0 unhealthy

metrics.duration_encoding: Fixed cumulative bucket series use names <family>_bucket_le_<bound>_total and <family>_bucket_le_inf_total, plus <family>_sum and <family>_count; no le label is used.

hysteresis.raw_accounting: Update total, good, and failed for every executed observation before any status threshold is applied.
hysteresis.status_accounting: Status may require consecutive failures to become 0 and consecutive successes to return to 1.
hysteresis.collector_rule: Use raw counters for the 99%/30d SLI; never derive the numerator or denominator from status transitions.
